sentences.text: This vibrant landscape resembles the modernist style popularized by Canada's famous Group of Seven in the early twentieth century.
Ce paysage vibrant rappelle le style moderniste popularisé par le célèbre Groupe des sept (Group of Seven) du Canada au début du XXe siècle.
Este vibrante paisaje recuerda el estilo modernista popularizado por el famoso Grupo de los Siete (Group of Seven) de Canadá a principios del siglo XX.
These artists traveled across the Canadian wilderness to capture rugged scenery in bold, expressive colors.
Ces artistes ont parcouru la nature sauvage canadienne pour capturer des paysages accidentés avec des couleurs vives et expressives.
Estos artistas viajaron por la naturaleza salvaje canadiense para capturar paisajes escarpados con colores llamativos y expresivos.
I can tell you more about Canadian landscape art.
Je peux vous en dire plus sur l'art du paysage canadien.
Puedo contarte más sobre el arte del paisaje canadiense.

vocabulary.meaning: A depiction of natural inland scenery in art.
Having a rough, uneven, and wild terrain.
A celebrated twentieth-century school of Canadian landscape painters.

concepts.title: The Group of Seven and Canadian Identity
concepts.summary: The Group of Seven pioneered a distinct, modernist style to portray Canada's rugged wilderness using bold colors.
concepts.why_it_matters: Their artwork helped shape Canadian visual culture and national identity through an appreciation of the northern landscape.
